reviews.title: No Apple Watch support
reviews.text:
The app hasn’t supported Apple Watch in a while. That needs to be updated on the app’s App Store page. 

Showing that the app supports Apple Watch in the information section is a major factor in getting people to download it and subscribe.

reviews.title: My personal fitness companion!!
reviews.text:
After I hit 20 years old, I realized the need for exercise is a life time project. I’ve learned over time the importance of having a trainer, the need to focus on the whole body, and Sworkit does the hard work by putting together complete workouts that I can do anywhere. 
 Sworkit is the answer. It's what keeps me going. 
69 strong!

reviews.title: Lovin’ It
reviews.text: Sworkit has been such a great reintroduction to my fitness routine. The guided interval routines are a huge value to a home workout. I am looking forward to what I become next year as I race into my exercise adventure.

reviews.title: 4 stars
reviews.text: I gave them a 4 beacuse the adult work outs aren’t free. The kids are other than that it is good to have. Love it just the subscription.

reviews.title: Really great fitness tracker and app
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for a couple months now and it’s really kept me on track with staying acting and keeping score of all my outside activities.. if your looking for a good work out app I would recommend this one!

reviews.title: Long time user
reviews.text:
I’ve been a user for years.  I have the old app that still worked for me except I couldn’t make updates so tried to find a new app and discovered this one.
Love it!!

reviews.title: Long time fan
reviews.text: My favorite fitness app bar none

reviews.title: Do not recommend
reviews.text: It says it syncs with Apple health but will not sync and pulls not data. No way of inputting fitness data from Apple device into AP

reviews.title: Always come back to this app
reviews.text: I am no Olympian here; I just need plug-and-play workouts without decisions and specialized equipment. I love that SWORKIT is powerful enough for days when I'm high energy, and simple enough for my low energy days. Other apps may be great for certain personalities or fitness/experience levels...but SWORKIT has never failed me. Excited to return here in the fog of postpartum and always be just one click away from a workout I can squeeze in around my busy baby's schedule. Thanks Team SWORKIT! Movement for health & wellness doesn't have to be complicated (unless you're into that, then go for it!)

reviews.title: Great options for fitness.
reviews.text: I enjoy being able to choose so many options. The app allows me to achieve a high level of fitness. It motivates and keeps me moving.

reviews.title: Easy
reviews.text: I am so thankful for this app. Sworkit makes my morning routine easy and helps me be consistent with my goals.

reviews.title: Love it !
reviews.text: I know im gonna sound like a bot but the workouts are very quick and easy and shorter workout are easy to be consistent with

reviews.title: worth the $$$ get it NOW
reviews.text: Coming from someone who was 202lbs and now 143lbs just take it from me !! This app is the best. I’ve always had gym anxiety due to my weight insecurities but also not being confident in my exercises (especially form).But this app gave me a reason to say screw the gym membership and make the comfort of my own home a gym while also giving me the confidence with my form and learning a variety of workouts I didn’t know existed ! I love how they categorize from strength , cardio, yoga etc. it’s literally catered for anyone !! I pray they continue to make this app great , add more workouts and features to keep it exciting . So far I love it and it motivates me to try harder everyday ❤️thanks to Sworkit I am now WorkinIt 🥹

reviews.title: This is AWESOME!!
reviews.text: I just got this app yesterday, and both days at around 4 PM I did a workout that targeted losing weight and toning you’re body and I am already seeing a difference. I am sweating during it and I am burning about 120 calories each time I do it. I am 11 years old and I’ve been doing this with my mom and we both love this app. Thank you for providing an app that actually helps! AND young teens can use it!! I am so happy!

reviews.title: Customized for my needs
reviews.text: I’ve been using Sworkit off and on for many years, and it has served me well. Traveling, I can download workouts and do them anywhere. More recently, I’ve customized workouts to help with recovery from various injuries. I also appreciate that each exercise has a full explanation and illustration to show exactly what muscles are targeted. Keeps getting better too! Great app!

reviews.title: I love it
reviews.text: Best fitness app I ever used

reviews.title: Exceptionally easy to track workouts!
reviews.text: This app is very user friendly and I have had zero issues or complaints trying to back track workouts or enter them in day of. I love that my Apple Watch can sync with it, I also love the workout videos because sometimes the hardest part of working out is trying to decide which workout to do. I also enjoy how the assessments physically track how well you’re doing via camera. This app is a great improvement to my physical health regimen!

reviews.title: Perfect home workout app
reviews.text: Great and easy to use to stay in shape.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: I haven’t had such bad customer service. I messaged the customer support and they would ask me what is wrong and I would tell them the issue then ghost me. I set this account up with my company to track steps and the app won’t sync and they will not help me.

reviews.title: Great way to stay motivated!
reviews.text: Love how many chooses you can choose from, really helps out with motivation if you struggle with that.

reviews.title: Improvement in life
reviews.text: I have seen a serious improvement in my muscles using this app. I didn’t think I would ever get as strong as some people around me but using this app I truly have. This app has also allowed me to learn discipline by continuing to go forward with something even if it pains me. I truly love this app and I’m super glad that I was able to use it for free during my online fitness class. I finished my online fitness class in April and I’m still using it today through a subscription

reviews.title: Sworkit is helping me to keep motivated on my fitness journey
reviews.text: I love all the different workout videos at different levels. I can do a quick workout for breaks, etc. Thanks!

reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text: So, Basically I’m having to use this for my schools HOPE class over the summer and it’s not bad but, I wouldn’t use this day to day to be honest it’s not  as convenient as I wish it was. Personally I have a Garmin watch and it helps me record workouts sooooo much easier that this app.

reviews.title: Buggy app, annoying notifications
reviews.text: This app needs a lot of work. I keep unsubscribing from their emails, which send useless reminders to do things AFTER I’ve already done them. The workout exercises are badly structured and hard to follow. Not great.

reviews.title: No way to cancel
reviews.text: I made the mistake of signing up for this app from the website. The only way to cancel from there is through a chatbot that no one responds to. There has also been no reply to my emails requesting support. Horrible customer service.

reviews.title: Sworkit
reviews.text: Me ayuda a cumplir con mi objetivo de bajar de peso. Tiene programas de acuerdo a lo que quieres lograr y lo puedo adaptar a mi rutina diaria con el tiempo que mejor se adapta a mi día a día. Ejercicios enfocados a lo que deseo lograr⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.title: Great variety
reviews.text:
I’ve been on Sworkit for several years.  Just passed 1500 workouts.  Love the variety of workouts from stretching to cardio to resistance.  Love the monthly and seasonal challenges.   Pick a workout and it’s all organized.  You even get a personal trainer to help you along.  I can track all my workouts and customize what I want to do next.  

Love the app

reviews.title: Love Sworkit
reviews.text: I’ve had sworkit for years, and it’s my favorite workout app.

reviews.title: STILL ACTIVE APP!!🥳🥳
reviews.text: Thanks for being active. A decade later and I’m back to all the Sworkit apps!!!

reviews.title: The best for stretching
reviews.text: Excellent web site! Easy to follow instructions and very helpful with the time to complete work outs.

reviews.title: Well explained wide variety of exercises
reviews.text: See title.

reviews.title: Amazing !💪🏼
reviews.text:
This app helps me stay in shape and it’s VERY VERY VERY easy to understand and figure out how to use. The exercise list is HUGE, so you definitely will be able to find an exercise that will suit you well whether you want to tone up, lose weight, or just be healthy! The is stretching, cardio, tai chi, and WAYYY more! 
I find this all very useful and would definitely recommend this to someone over paying for a gym membership…!

reviews.title: Great home workout
reviews.text: For me, this is a great place to get some strength training at home in between runs. They even have a run warm up and injured knee recovery series which I have used. Whether you have minimal equipment or just want to use body weight exercises, there are good workout options here.

reviews.title: Wonderful App
reviews.text: Wonderful app that helps you on track!

reviews.title: Good app for everyone
reviews.text: Had this app forever and it’s never let me down. From pregnancy workouts, fast HIIT workouts to a easier Yoga workout. It’s even helped me get back into working out when I’ve fallen off a routine. Well worth every penny.

reviews.title: Doesnt work
reviews.text: Dont believe the reviews, this is the most poorly put together app i have ever seen. 99% of the time it doesnt open, and if it does, most likely most of the things in there either dont work, or are broken due to terrible coding.

reviews.title: App has too many glitches
reviews.text: I’ve tried multiple times to log my workouts pull up a workout add information and it doesn’t let me and it does the multiple screens over don’t let me save any of my information. I’ve deleted the app and re-downloaded it multiple times. The institution I work for use this app so that we can track our health and earn points and I can’t do that cause the app won’t work.

reviews.title: Variety of workouts & very customizable
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for more than 10 years and have always really enjoyed it. I’ve tried other apps but always find myself coming back to this app. It motivates me to reach my goals and I highly recommend it.

reviews.title: Great easy workout app!
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app with my online PE class and I honestly really like it. It lets me create my own workouts tailored to me and what I can do. I love that you get to see a real person doing each workout too. It has helped me so much. Highly recommend this app!

reviews.title: Great tool to motivate work out
reviews.text: Since I downloaded Sworkit I have been more motivated to exercise. They have a variety of workouts that will fit almost all levels.

reviews.title: Easy to use
reviews.text: I’ve have used a lot of platforms for health through my company. This one is by far the easiest, most visually appealing, and comprehensive one. Great app!

reviews.title: Good but…
reviews.text: I enjoyed the workouts but sometimes it gets a glitch with the workouts. But so far so good since it has three levels to take it at your own pace and you get to select the time interval. I am really glad my employer got us this way to help us stay healthy.

reviews.title: Great App
reviews.text: Okay it doesn’t do the work for me but using this app is a great tool in my health & exercise program. So many options for whatever your fitness level.

reviews.title: personal training is useless
reviews.text: I am training for a running race so i asked for some help putting together a training program.  They sent me a generic pdf on how to train for a race.  When I said I wanted a little more direction and a detailed plan, and maybe someone to check in on me, they just said good luck, we don’t offer that service. So I guess by “personal training” they mean no personalization at all. I put my current running and goals into Claude and got a great personalized plan in a few seconds. This app is not worth your time!!!  And if you just need workouts peloton is better.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Seems to only pick up steps from my Apple Watch not extra exercise or calorie burn

reviews.title: 2nd lesson
reviews.text: I first learned Yang-style tai chi 30 years ago but have been away from it for years following minor knee surgery. The pace of the instruction is perfect to allow my right knee to get stronger and more stable. It will take awhile.

reviews.title: Issue with teams in challenges
reviews.text: The app is pretty decent. It has cool features such as workouts and stretching. The stretching workouts just cycle through rather than add to it. Doing 15 minutes of stretching you go through the cycle just over two times. The biggest headache is joining a corporate challenge. You can join a team but then you can’t easily find your team to see how you are doing. You have to scroll through all of the teams to find yours. Not sure why you can’t go to the challenge and see your team or go to your team and see the challenges you are in. Would be a huge improvement/necessary update to fix that.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: I’m really enjoying this app. It’s really helpful and easy to navigate. I’m glad that my job introduced me to this app and is actively encouraging us to be the best that we can be health wise. I like the challenge that are offered along with the choices of workouts among other options.

reviews.title: Doesn’t sync well
reviews.text: In a day of technology, I absolutely hate when apps don’t sync together and don’t sync well.
